pumi.controlplane.v1.DecideRequest.jsons.description:
DecideRequest is the request of Decide. It names the facts by their keys
 and carries no fact values: the control plane projects each fact that the
 action's context declares from its own log, and reads the profile settings
 and the hard caps itself (decision 0155). A fact that has not been
 produced is missing, and the request is denied (decision 0143).

action.description: The Cedar action, as named in pumi.cedarschema, such as merge.

cause.description:
The id of the event that led to the decision, such as the trigger of a
 transition, which the decision.made event names as its cause (decision
 0133), or empty. The kernel finds the decisions it made for a trigger by
 it when it starts again (decision 0187).

keys.description: The keys that the facts are looked up by.

plan.description: The plan, which is the Cedar resource.

pumi.controlplane.v1.DecideRequest.jsons.title: Decide Request

pumi.controlplane.v1.FactKeys.jsonschema.description:
FactKeys are the keys that the facts of a decision are looked up by
 (decision 0136). A key that does not apply to the action is empty.

invocation.description: The invocation, where the action is about one.

pumi.controlplane.v1.FactKeys.jsonschema.title: Fact Keys
